title: Finite-stage canonical triple overlap equation
statement:
theorem finitePresentation_overlap_triple_canonical_eventually
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [∀ k : I, IsNoetherianRing (R.obj k)]
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (U : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).OpenCover.{u})
    [Finite U.I₀] [∀ a, IsAffine (U.X a)]
    (N : (a : U.I₀) → (U.X a).Modules)
    (a b d : U.I₀)
    (hN : ∀ a, (N a).IsFinitePresentation) (hNq : ∀ a, (N a).IsQuasicoherent)
    :
    ∀ (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k),
      let q₀ := overlapStageMap R f hij hjk
      let V₀ : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk))))).OpenCover.{u} :=
        U.pullback₁ q₀
      let p₀ := overlapLimitMap R c f (hij.trans hjk)
      ∀ T : modulesPseudofunctor.OverlapTransitions V₀.f,
        (∀ a, Nonempty ((T.obj a : (V₀.X a).Modules) ≅
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q₀ a)).obj (N a))) →
        (T.pull (p := p₀) (α := fun a ↦ a)
          (fun a ↦ V₀.pullbackHom_map p₀ a)).Coherent →
        ∃ (l : I) (hkl : k ≤ l), ∀ (m : I) (hkm : k ≤ m), l ≤ m →
          let q := overlapStageMap R f hij (hjk.trans hkm)
          let V : (pullback f (Spec.map
              (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans (hjk.trans hkm)))))).OpenCover.{u} :=
            U.pullback₁ q
          let r := overlapStageMap R f (hij.trans hjk) hkm
          let s := overlapRefinementHom U q₀ q r
            (overlapStageMap_comp R f hij hjk hkm)
          let T' := T.pull (p := r) (α := fun a ↦ a) (p' := s)
            (fun a ↦ overlapRefinementHom_map U q₀ q r
              (overlapStageMap_comp R f hij hjk hkm) a)
          ∃ sq : ∀ x y, ChosenPullback (V.f x) (V.f y),
          ∃ sq₃ : ∀ x y z, ChosenPullback₃ (sq x y) (sq y z) (sq x z),
            T'.hom (sq₃ a b d).p (sq₃ a b d).p₁ (sq₃ a b d).p₂
                (sq₃ a b d).w₁ (sq₃ a b d).w₂ ≫
              T'.hom (sq₃ a b d).p (sq₃ a b d).p₂ (sq₃ a b d).p₃
                (sq₃ a b d).w₂ (sq₃ a b d).w₃ =
              T'.hom (sq₃ a b d).p (sq₃ a b d).p₁ (sq₃ a b d).p₃
                (sq₃ a b d).w₁ (sq₃ a b d).w₃

proof.text: Construct the pairwise chosen pullbacks and their threefold chosen pullback explicitly. The base-changed cover charts are affine because the stage map is affine. Quasi-separatedness of the stage and quasi-compactness of its affine charts make the threefold overlap quasi-compact over Spec(R_k). The prescribed component isomorphisms show that the two endpoint modules on the overlap are finitely presented and quasi-coherent.

On this threefold overlap form delta = T12 composed with T23 minus T13. Lift its three projections to the limit cover by pullback.lift. The hypothesis of limit coherence gives the composition equation there. Transition naturality and cancellation of the pseudofunctor comparison isomorphisms identify this equation with zero of the pullback of delta to the limit test scheme.
Apply finitePresentation_test_map_zero_eventually to the overlap projection and delta to obtain l at which its native pullback is zero.

For m above l construct the usual chosen threefold overlap of the cover at m. Its three projections followed by the cover refinement maps give a lift phi to the overlap at k. The stage composition law factors phi through the test-scheme pullback at l. Additivity of module pullback and naturality of pullbackComp show that the pullback of delta along phi is zero. The proved triple_pull_iff cancels the comparison isomorphisms and yields the required composition equation for T at m. Use the explicit chosen pair and triple families as the two existential witnesses.
